vulnerability.explanation: In the 16-bit PNG_COLOR_TYPE_RGB_ALPHA path, the loop processes R, G, and B (each 2 bytes) with sp += 2 after each, then incorrectly does sp += 4 to skip the alpha channel. This advances sp by 10 bytes per pixel when the pixel size is 8 bytes, causing subsequent iterations to read from and write to memory past the end of the row buffer (e.g., dereferencing sp and sp+1 and writing back to them). The correct increment after processing B should be sp += 2 (skip the 2-byte alpha), not 4.
